text_zh: 杭州市文化广电旅游局2024年7月发布的入园通知取消全市A级景区（文博场馆除外）的普通预约要求，并将西湖风景名胜区列为对象；法定节假日客流大时景区可能采取流量提示或错峰分流。本条仅指公共湖滨步行游览，不含灵隐飞来峰等独立景区、内设文博场馆、收费点、游船和活动。免预约不表示所有内部场所免票；常规每周开放安排和提前购票窗口本条均未核定，临时安全管控、天气和局部封闭须查行前公告。
text_en: A July 2024 notice from Hangzhou’s culture and tourism bureau removes ordinary reservation requirements for the city’s A-rated scenic areas (other than museums) and names West Lake Scenic Area; on busy statutory holidays crowd alerts or staggered entry may apply. This entry covers public lakeside walking only, excluding independent attractions such as Lingyin Feilai Peak, museums, ticketed sites, boats and events. Reservation-free access does not establish free entry to every internal site. Regular weekly opening arrangements and any advance ticket-purchase window are not confirmed here; check notices for temporary safety controls, weather and local closures.

text_zh: 杭州市文化广电旅游局2024年7月发布的入园通知把西溪湿地旅游区列入取消预约的A级景区，普通园区入园不需另行预约；法定节假日客流大时景区可能采取流量提示或错峰分流。免预约不等于免门票、保证当天有票或所有项目都免约；内设文博场馆、游船及具体活动另查。本条未核定常规每周闭园日和提前购票窗口，临时及局部关闭行前查看景区最新通知。
text_en: A July 2024 notice from Hangzhou’s culture and tourism bureau lists Xixi Wetland among A-rated scenic areas whose ordinary park admission no longer needs a separate reservation; on busy statutory holidays the area may use crowd alerts or staggered entry. Reservation-free admission does not mean free tickets, guaranteed availability or booking-free access to every facility; museums, boats and events have separate arrangements. Regular weekly closures and any advance purchase window are not confirmed here; check the park’s latest notices for temporary and local closures before travelling.

subject.name_en: Yue Fei Memorial Museum (inside Yue Fei Temple)

text_zh: 杭州市文旅局公布的错时开放名单将岳飞纪念馆列为每天开放，本条没有常规每周闭馆日。纪念馆位于岳王庙内，这项说明仅限纪念馆，不据此保证整个岳庙、墓园或临时展厅同样开放。预约是否必需及购票窗口尚未核定，行前核对岳庙最新参观公告；较早公布的试行安排不保证当日无临时调整。
text_en: Hangzhou’s culture and tourism bureau lists Yue Fei Memorial Museum in its daily-opening category, with no regular weekly closing day. The museum is inside Yue Fei Temple; this record does not establish opening arrangements for the entire temple, cemetery or temporary galleries. Mandatory booking and the ticket-purchase window are unconfirmed here. Check the temple’s latest visitor notice: the earlier published trial arrangement does not guarantee access on a particular day.
